purpose_string: Four observed QwertyStock motion references for a coherent Maya and Leo story. This is source selection only; no GPU generation or paid download was performed.

maya_object.role_string: finds the clue and asks Leo to meet

leo_object.role_string: joins Maya and helps interpret the clue

existing_keyframes_object.note_string: These are existing identity/scene keyframes, not proof of accepted video identity.

search_contract_object.authentication_string: none for public search and watermarked preview URLs
search_contract_object.license_string: Public watermarked previews are selected only for evaluation/sample use. Purchase the chosen production formats before commercial production use under the applicable Qwertystock Royalty-Free End User License.
search_contract_object.source_sha256_note_string: The public search response does not expose an original-source SHA-256. No paid/original asset was downloaded. Each locally reviewed four-second preview segment has its own SHA-256 below; URL path hashes are recorded only as URL provenance and are not claimed to be file hashes.

requirements_array: landscape framing compatible with 960x540 without a portrait crop
one simple observable action per shot
faces and principal hands visible enough for continuous review
story prompt must describe only action visible in the selected preview window

sources_array.search_query_string: adult woman holding phone reading message
sources_array.catalog_title_string: Digital Focus in Nature's Gentle Embrace
sources_array.observed_action_string: A hooded adult woman stands outdoors against soft green foliage, holds a black smartphone in one hand, and reads its screen with a focused expression.
sources_array.story_action_string: Maya reads a message containing a clue on her phone and decides to contact Leo.
sources_array.generation_prompt_string: Maya, an adult woman in her consistent mustard jacket, stands outdoors against softly blurred green foliage and reads a black smartphone held in one hand. Her face remains fully visible and focused. Locked landscape medium close-up, natural daylight, subtle breathing and eye movement, one person, anatomically correct hand and phone.
sources_array.quality_rationale_string: One stable frontal/three-quarter face, one visible phone hand, no camera motion, no other people, and little occlusion.

sources_array.search_query_string: adult man walking city approaching camera
sources_array.catalog_title_string: Confident young adult businessman walking outside close to office building
sources_array.observed_action_string: An adult man walks steadily from left to right through a bright modern concourse; his side-profile face remains visible and his upper body stays centered.
sources_array.story_action_string: Leo walks through the station concourse toward Maya's meeting place.
sources_array.generation_prompt_string: Leo, an adult man in his consistent teal shirt, walks steadily through a bright modern station concourse toward the meeting point. Keep his side-profile face recognizable and his full upper body stable. Gentle side-tracking landscape medium shot, restrained natural gait, one person, straight background architecture, realistic anatomy.
sources_array.quality_rationale_string: Single unobstructed adult, continuously visible face and torso, simple gait, gentle predictable tracking, and no hand-object interaction.

sources_array.search_query_string: adult man woman greeting each other
sources_array.catalog_title_string: Adult man and woman colleagues discussing building plan in office
sources_array.observed_action_string: An adult woman and man stand side by side, lean over a large paper plan on a table, and point or trace details while discussing it. A laptop stays open beside the plan.
sources_array.story_action_string: Maya and Leo meet and compare the clue with a large paper map, tracing the marked location together.
sources_array.generation_prompt_string: Maya in her consistent mustard jacket and Leo in his consistent teal shirt stand side by side at a table, lean over one large paper map, and calmly trace a marked location together. Keep exactly two distinct adult identities, both faces visible in three-quarter view, four anatomically correct hands, one stable paper map, and one open laptop. Locked landscape medium-wide shot, moderate gestures, no extra people.
sources_array.quality_rationale_string: Exactly two adults, stable locked camera, both faces persist in frame, and the shared paper action directly supports the clue beat. Hands and paper contact remain a deliberate acceptance gate.

sources_array.search_query_string: adult man woman meet smile cafe
sources_array.catalog_title_string: Young man and woman enjoy a lively conversation at a cozy cafe, surrounded by warm lights and a relaxed atmosphere. Smiling faces create a sense of connection and happiness
sources_array.observed_action_string: A seated adult man faces camera and smiles while speaking to an adult woman seen from behind across a cafe table. Their movement is restrained and conversational.
sources_array.story_action_string: Back at the cafe, Maya and Leo smile and talk after understanding where the clue leads.
sources_array.generation_prompt_string: Maya in her consistent mustard jacket and Leo in his consistent teal shirt sit across a small cafe table and share a relieved smile while talking quietly. Use the existing Maya-and-Leo cafe keyframe for identity and composition. Keep exactly two adults, Leo's face visible toward camera, Maya in stable over-the-shoulder view, correct hands, warm cafe lights, and a locked landscape medium shot.
sources_array.quality_rationale_string: Very stable camera and moderate expressions; one face is fully reviewable while the second identity is intentionally over-the-shoulder, matching the observed source instead of inventing a two-face frontal shot.

story_outline_array.description_string: Maya reads a phone message containing a location clue.
Leo walks through a station-like concourse toward Maya.
Together they trace the clue on a large paper map.
They return to the cafe, smile, and discuss what they found.

acceptance_notes_array: The four references define motion and framing only; source actors must not replace Maya or Leo identity.
Shot 3 must be rejected if identities blend, swap, or hands merge with the map.
Shot 4 intentionally shows Maya mainly from behind; it cannot alone prove Maya facial identity.
Every generated shot still requires continuous playback review for faces, hands/anatomy, people count, action, camera, and temporal coherence.
No selected preview or contact sheet is a production license or a completed story render.
